title: Crypto-Agility Manifest
description: A small, versioned, machine-readable JSON document a project publishes at /.well-known/crypto-agility.json to declare its cryptographic posture, CBOM summary, optional attestation link, migration policy, and optional self-declared conformance. See draft-acosta-crypto-agility-manifest-01.

version.description: Manifest schema version. Consumers MUST branch on it and MUST reject a version they do not understand. This document describes version 1.

manifestType.description: Discriminator so a consumer can tell this document apart from other JSON served at a well-known path.

generatedAt.description: When the manifest was generated, as an ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 timestamp.

name.description: Name of the tool that generated the manifest.

root.description: The scanned root the manifest describes.

repository.description: Source repository URL, or null when unknown.

commit.description: Commit identifier the manifest was derived from, or null when unknown.

readinessScore.description: Readiness score from 0 to 100. 100 means no classical asymmetric cryptography was found.

hybridKexInUse.description: Whether the project negotiates hybrid post-quantum key exchange. null means not determined by this generator, which is distinct from false.

bySeverity.description: Counts keyed by severity. All keys MUST be present.

hndlExposedCount.description: How many findings are exposed to harvest-now-decrypt-later.

cbomSummary.description: A compact summary of, and pointer to, the full CycloneDX CBOM.

serialNumber.description: The CycloneDX serialNumber (urn:uuid:...) of the full CBOM this summary was derived from.

assetCount.description: Number of distinct cryptographic-asset components in the full CBOM.

algorithmFamilies.description: Per algorithm family in use, most-referenced first.

family.description: Algorithm family name, for example RSA or ECDH.

count.description: Number of references to this family.

attestation.description: Optional link to a machine-verifiable posture credential. The URL is recorded verbatim and is not fetched by the generator. Omitted when none is declared.

policy.description: The migration policy the project declares it is measured against.

source.description: Label for the policy source: a standard's name, or operator-declared.

deprecateClassicalAfter.description: Year after which classical public-key cryptography is deprecated.

disallowClassicalAfter.description: Year after which classical public-key cryptography is disallowed.

transitionDeadline.description: An operator-declared migration deadline (ISO date or year), or null.

conformance.description: Optional. The subject's self-declared conformance to its stated policy, with any residual quantum-vulnerable findings enumerated as justified exceptions. A self-published status is a claim, not a proof: a consumer MUST NOT treat a 'conformant' or 'conditional' status as assurance unless the manifest also carries an 'attestation' that covers it. Omitted when not declared.

policy.description: Label for the policy this conformance is asserted against. SHOULD match the 'source' of the 'policy' object.

status.description: conformant: the subject meets the declared policy outright. conditional: the subject does not meet the numeric bar, but every residual quantum-vulnerable finding is enumerated in 'exceptions' with a justification. nonconformant: residual findings exist without accepted exceptions.

statement.description: Optional human-readable rationale for the status.

exceptions.description: Optional. Residual quantum-vulnerable findings the subject accepts, each with a justification. Present the residual findings that keep the readiness score below 100 but are accepted under the declared policy.

family.description: Algorithm family or finding this exception covers, for example RSA or X25519.

justification.description: Why this residual finding is accepted under the declared policy.

acceptedUntil.description: Optional year the exception is accepted until, typically aligned with a policy deadline, or null.
